confirmed_semantics: P28: every navigation from Round 2 has one fixed authoritative 15000ms neutral NAV_SETTING window. Only the eligible Officer sees unresolved genuine-tie controls. Early choice changes no other audience packet/revision/event or deadline. Final direction is withheld from every office until the interval closes. Existing equal-probability fallback, P09 confirmations, Round 1 and P27 are preserved.

R13: Meet A/B evaluates the giver alone in the final authoritative voting-start location. No Jail Vote means not voting against the recipient. Quota true means lifetime slot used. Election IDs are opaque; do not manufacture a future round.

P14/R8: Engineer receives their server-fixed identities, including an empty capture. The activation/capture is per-world and inherits or is discarded with the complete selected state; no target/office/public notification.

P21/P22/R12 and BH-ATTEMPT-04: patient attempt/result knowledge remains global and patient-private. Correct accepted input reserves one shared injection and queues its world-local request. Inherited retained reservations remain queued without duplication; a missing selected reservation yields DISCARDED without restoring the attempt. WRONG never reserved an injection. TREATED is this request causing Injured to Healthy at its Rescue step; retained NO_EFFECT still spends its reservation. No new refund, healing pool or immediate heal.

An otherwise eligible unused patient receives uniform NO_INJECTION when the actor-world pool is empty, before correctness is checked. No attempt, reservation or correctness fact is produced. Accepted REGISTERED remains registration, not healing.
